name: Bai Xiao
source:
This is an adventurous story about friendship and love.

Xiao Ziyun, a lonely tenth grader, accidentally stumbles upon a legend about a white cat that can transform into a girl, and about an invisible "non-material" friend on campus.

In the rainy season, she meets a girl named Bai Xiao, and the story unfolds.

Set in a southern Chinese school, the story captures the atmosphere of companionship, laughter, and a warm daily life.

However, Xiao Ziyun gradually realizes that Bai Xiao has many more secrets to hide...

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895920/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于友情和爱情的冒险故事。

孤独的十年级学生肖子云偶然发现了一个关于一只可以变成女孩的白猫和一个校园里看不见的“非物质”朋友的传说。

雨季里，她遇见了一个叫白晓的女孩，故事就此展开。

故事发生在中国南方的一所学校，充满了陪伴、欢笑和温暖的日常生活。

然而，萧子云渐渐发现，白晓还有很多秘密要隐藏……

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895920/]Steam[/url]]
